svg.title: A retry is another budgeted attempt
svg.desc: After a model-call error, first require both a retryable classification and remaining retry, time, and budget allowance. Otherwise stop with the recorded reason. Bound any backoff by the remaining deadline. Recheck deadline and reservation eligibility after waiting and before recording and dispatching a new attempt. Another error returns to the classification and allowance gate; success returns to the normal harness. Unknown usage from an earlier timeout retains its reservation until reconciliation.
